title: Yixuan39/targetasm samplesheet
description: One row per sample: PacBio HiFi reads, plus an optional sample name (default: the reads file name) and per-sample target_bases.

sample.errorMessage: Sample names must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens

reads.errorMessage: Reads must be an existing FASTQ file (.fastq or .fq, optionally gzipped) with no spaces in its path

target_bases.errorMessage: target_bases must be a whole number of bases, e.g. 5400000000 or 5.4e9; leave empty to use --target_bases
